title: Research: independently audit every T740 hosted-phase transport
body:
## Summary

Adds an independent source-premise audit for PR3309 at `94d97babee3fdb68c6f84f3013949841eec7061c`.

```text
literal base fill + ten-copy lift + 145 edits
  -> actual caller widths and physical streams
  -> reverse last-touch barriers
  -> all 2,717,280 hosted rows transport legally to their residual sites
```

The new implementation executes no predecessor code. Its nine transport receipt fields agree across all 740 owners and 112 ports. PR3309 retains credit for normalization; PR3297 retains the inverse/rank theorem. PR3306's independent matrix audit covers owner0/port0. This contribution checks the complete hosted-row transport premise, with no new rank profile, supplier or kappa claim.

Base `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. Scientific commit `b532f3f8e92bc67cb327ca3f6187013b852fd93c`; the follow-up commit only retains the actual designated peer receipt. Exact predecessor proof/receipt bytes are included, so fresh CI needs no pending PR Git objects. Open next questions and inherited obligations are in the package.

## Evidence

- Before: complete transport relied on the predecessor implementation. After: reverse-barrier reconstruction matches all 82,880 contexts, full cut histogram and residual profiles. Five optimized control groups reject chronology, stream, occupancy, journal and source-contract corruptions, including a real private verifier process.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay and both actual committed read-only Git-free commands pass. Ruff E/F/I/B/UP and format checks pass. Regular-only, private-inode export and unchanged bytes are checked.
- Worker 1 inspected the actual proof/code/sources, reran both optimized read-only commands, checked all scientific Git/export bytes and independently matched all 180 child/stage intervals. The exact scoped receipt is retained verbatim in `REVIEW.json`.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t740-hosted-transport-audit
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds one research package and opt-in replay. The all-port symbolic matrix, inverse/rank consequence, completed-call/native interpretation, full supplier and consumer, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, human and proof-kernel review remain inherited or unrun. No selected or frozen source changes.

Credit PR3309/3187, thakrarsagar/PR3297/3272, Tekalign/PR3306/3204, Gonzalo Mier/PR3263/3199/1252, Ross Richardson, Jeremy Diviney/PR3148, Rohan Arun, dcharb78/PR3133 and the retained provider/geometry lineage. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19005516).
